gaps.sentence: The report was highly ___ (CRITIC) of the new scheme.
gaps.explanation: 'Highly critical of' — the adjective describing a judgement.

gaps.sentence: Their ___ (FRIEND) goes back to their university days.
gaps.explanation: 'Friendship' is the relationship between friends; 'friendliness' is a manner.

gaps.sentence: Rising sea levels ___ (THREAT) the very existence of the island.
gaps.explanation: A main verb is needed after the plural subject: threaten.

gaps.sentence: The project was abandoned for ___ (FINANCE) reasons.
gaps.explanation: An adjective is needed before 'reasons': financial.

gaps.sentence: The committee reached its verdict after lengthy ___ (DELIBERATE).
gaps.explanation: 'After lengthy deliberation' — the noun for careful discussion.

gaps.sentence: The film was a critical and ___ (COMMERCE) success.
He's an ___ (ENTHUSIASM) supporter of the team.
